recipes.name: Masala Chai
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp tea leaves, 1 cup milk, 1½ cups water, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp cardamom, ¼ tsp cinnamon, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil water with ginger and spices. 2. (5 min) Add tea, simmer briefly, add milk and sugar, strain.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Adrak Chai
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp tea leaves, 1 cup milk, 1½ cups water, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated fresh ginger, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Crush ginger, simmer with water and tea, add milk and sugar, strain hot.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Elaichi Chai
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp tea leaves, 1 cup milk, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp cardamom, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Crush cardamom. 2. (5 min) Simmer tea and cardamom in water, add milk and sugar, strain.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Lemon Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp black tea, 1½ cups water, ½ lemon juice, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew tea in hot water. 2. (4 min) Strain, then add lemon juice and sugar.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Filter Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp coffee powder, 1½ cups hot water, 1 cup milk, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew strong coffee decoction, mix with hot milk and sugar, froth between two cups.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Ginger Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp coffee powder, 1 cup milk, 1½ cups water, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Infuse ginger in water, add coffee decoction and hot milk, sweeten.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Cold Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp instant coffee, 1 cup chilled milk, 1–2 tsp sugar, 4–6 cubes ice
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Blend coffee, milk, sugar and ice until frothy; serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Badam Milk
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup milk, 2 tbsp almonds, to taste / as needed — saffron, ¼ tsp cardamom, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Soak and peel almonds, blend with a little milk, simmer with remaining milk and spices.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Haldi Doodh
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup milk, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp jaggery
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Warm milk with turmeric and pepper. 2. (5 min) Sweeten with jaggery after lowering heat.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Aam Panna
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — raw mango, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp black salt, 1–2 tsp jaggery, 2 tbsp chopped mint
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil raw mango, extract pulp, blend with spices and jaggery, dilute with chilled water.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Jal Jeera
recipes.ingredients: 2 tbsp chopped mint, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp roasted cumin, ½ lemon, ¼ tsp black salt, ½ cup water
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Blend herbs and spices with water, strain if desired, add lemon and chill.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Chaas
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup yogurt, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk yogurt with water. 2. (4 min) Mix in roasted cumin, ginger, herbs and salt.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Sweet Lassi
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup yogurt, ½ cup chilled water or milk, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Blend yogurt, liquid, sugar and cardamom until smooth.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — ripe mango, ½ cup yogurt, 1 cup milk, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Blend mango pulp with yogurt, milk, sugar and cardamom.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Nimbu Pani
recipes.ingredients: ½ lemon, ½ cup water, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp black salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix lemon juice, water, sugar and black salt; chill and serve.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Sattu Sharbat
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup roasted gram flour, ½ cup water, ½ lemon, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp black salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk sattu into water until smooth; add lemon and spices.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Coconut Water Cooler
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup coconut water, ½ lemon, 2 tbsp chopped mint, 4–6 cubes ice
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix coconut water with lemon and mint; serve chilled.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Rose Milk
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup milk, to taste / as needed — rose syrup, 4–6 cubes ice
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Stir rose syrup into chilled milk and serve over ice.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potato, to taste / as needed — cauliflower, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp coriander powder
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Temper cumin, sauté onion, add spices, potato and cauliflower. 2. (12 min) Cover and cook until tender; finish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Aloo Matar
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potato, ½ cup green peas, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté cumin and onion, cook tomato-spice base, add potatoes and peas with water and simmer.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
recipes.ingredients: 2 eggplant, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ¼ tsp cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Roast eggplant until charred, peel and mash. 2. (12 min) Cook onion-tomato masala and fold in eggplant.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bhindi Masala
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — okra, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Dry and slice okra. 2. (12 min) Sauté until lightly crisp, then add onion and spices and cook until done.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Lau Ghonto
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — bottle gourd, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp turmeric, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook cubed gourd and potato with tempered cumin and ginger until soft and lightly dry.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Dhokar Dalna
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) chana dal, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Soak and grind dal, steam or fry seasoned cakes, then simmer them gently in a spiced tomato gravy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Cholar Dal-er Tarkari
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) chana dal, ¼ cup, grated coconut, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook chana dal until tender. 2. (16 min) Temper spices, add potato and coconut, combine and simmer.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Shukto
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — bitter gourd, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, to taste / as needed — raw banana, to taste / as needed — pumpkin, to taste / as needed — drumstick, to taste / as needed — poppy seed, to taste / as needed — mustard
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook mixed vegetables gently with panch phoron, ground poppy/mustard and milk-like light gravy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
recipes.ingredients: 100 g crumbled/grated paneer, ½ cup green peas, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brown paneer lightly. 2. (12 min) Prepare tomato-onion masala, add peas and water, then simmer paneer in gravy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
recipes.ingredients: 2 tbsp chopped spinach, 100 g crumbled/grated paneer, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Blanch spinach and blend. 2. (12 min) Cook aromatics, add spinach puree and spices, then fold in paneer.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Paneer Bhurji
recipes.ingredients: 100 g crumbled/grated paneer, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Crumble paneer. 2. (12 min) Sauté vegetables and spices, then stir in paneer and cook briefly.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Kadai Paneer
recipes.ingredients: 100 g crumbled/grated paneer, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, to taste / as needed — coriander seeds, 1 small finely chopped dried chilli
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Crush roasted spices. 2. (12 min) Cook tomato-onion base with capsicum and spices, then add paneer.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Vegetable Kofta Curry
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables, to taste / as needed — besan, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Shape seasoned vegetable mixture into balls and cook or fry. 2. (12 min) Simmer in onion-tomato gravy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Navratan Korma
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables, 100 g crumbled/grated paneer, to taste / as needed — nuts, ½ cup yogurt, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook vegetables separately. 2. (12 min) Make a mild onion-nut-yogurt gravy and combine with vegetables.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Methi Aloo
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potato, to taste / as needed — fresh fenugreek, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 small finely chopped chilli
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Sauté cumin and potatoes, add chopped fenugreek and spices, cover until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Jeera Aloo
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potato, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ¼ tsp turmeric, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Temper cumin, add potatoes and spices, toss until coated and lightly crisp.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Tori Masala
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — ridge gourd, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp cumin, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook ridge gourd in a dry onion-tomato masala until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Karela Pyaz
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — bitter gourd, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ¼ tsp fennel, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp amchur
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Salt and rest sliced bitter gourd, rinse and squeeze. 2. (12 min) Pan-cook with onion and spices until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Sabzi
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — pumpkin, ¼ tsp cumin, to taste / as needed — fenugreek seeds, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 small finely chopped chilli, 1–2 tsp jaggery
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Temper seeds, add pumpkin and spices, cover until soft; balance with a little jaggery.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Cabbage Peas
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — cabbage, ½ cup green peas, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté cumin and ginger, add cabbage, peas and spices; cook uncovered until just tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Beans Poriyal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) green beans, ¼ cup, grated coconut, ¼ tsp mustard seed, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Temper mustard and curry leaves, add beans and turmeric, cook crisp-tender and finish with coconut.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Carrot Beans Poriyal
recipes.ingredients: 1 small chopped carrot, ½ cup (dry) beans, ¼ cup, grated coconut, to taste / as needed — mustard, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Cook chopped vegetables with tempering until tender-crisp and finish with fresh coconut.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Avial
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables, ¼ cup, grated coconut, ½ cup yogurt, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook vegetables with little water. 2. (12 min) Grind coconut-cumin-chilli, fold in, finish with yogurt and coconut oil.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Kootu
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — vegetable, ½ cup (dry) moong dal, ¼ cup, grated coconut, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp pepper, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal and vegetable. 2. (12 min) Grind coconut-cumin-pepper, combine and simmer; finish with tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Mor Kuzhambu
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup yogurt, ¼ cup, grated coconut, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ¼ tsp turmeric, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk yogurt with ground coconut-spice paste. 2. (12 min) Warm gently without boiling and finish with tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Kaddu Ki Sabzi
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — pumpkin, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 small finely chopped chilli, ¼ tsp amchur
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook pumpkin with tempered cumin and spices until soft, balancing sweet and tangy flavors.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Tinda Masala
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — apple gourd, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté whole or quartered tinda, add masala and water, cover until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Arbi Masala
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — colocasia, to taste / as needed — ajwain, ¼ tsp turmeric, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp amchur
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Boil and peel arbi, slice, pan-sear and toss with ajwain and dry spices.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Gobi Matar
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — cauliflower, ½ cup peas, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté cauliflower and peas with a spiced tomato base until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Soybean Curry
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — soy chunks, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Soak soy chunks, squeeze well, simmer in onion-tomato gravy with spices.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) chickpeas, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 2 tsp tea or amla optional, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pressure-cook chickpeas. 2. (16 min) Prepare spiced onion-tomato masala and simmer chickpeas until thick.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Rajma Masala
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) kidney beans, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, ¼ tsp cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Soak and pressure-cook rajma. 2. (16 min) Simmer with bhuna onion-tomato masala until creamy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Lobia Masala
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup black-eyed peas, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Cook soaked lobia until tender, then simmer in spiced onion-tomato gravy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Kala Chana Masala
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) black chickpeas, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp cumin, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Pressure-cook soaked chana and finish in a thick spiced onion-tomato masala.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Tadka
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) yellow moong dal, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pressure-cook dal with turmeric. 2. (16 min) Temper cumin, garlic and tomato in ghee/oil and pour over dal.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Masoor Dal Tadka
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) red masoor dal, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook masoor until soft. 2. (16 min) Finish with onion, cumin, garlic and tomato tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Toor Dal Tadka
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 1 small finely chopped chilli
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pressure-cook dal, whisk smooth and finish with a hot cumin-garlic tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Dal Fry
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal until soft. 2. (16 min) Fry aromatics and spices, add dal and simmer to desired thickness.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Dal Palak
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, 2 tbsp chopped spinach, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, ¼ tsp cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal. 2. (16 min) Add chopped spinach and simmer briefly; finish with cumin-garlic tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Panchmel Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, ½ cup (dry) moong dal, ½ cup (dry) masoor dal, ½ cup (dry) chana dal, ½ cup (dry) urad dal, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Combine soaked dals, pressure-cook, then finish with a fragrant ghee tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Dal Dhokli
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, 1 cup wheat flour, 1 medium chopped tomato, 2 tbsp peanuts, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook seasoned dal. 2. (16 min) Roll wheat dough thin, cut pieces and simmer them in the dal until cooked.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Maharashtrian Amti
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, ¼ cup, grated coconut, to taste / as needed — tamarind, 1–2 tsp jaggery, to taste / as needed — goda masala
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal, add coconut, tamarind, jaggery and goda masala, then simmer.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Gujarati Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, 2 tbsp peanuts, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1–2 tsp jaggery, ½ kokum or lemon, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal and peanuts, then simmer with sweet-sour seasoning and tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bengali Masoor Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) masoor dal, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 small finely chopped dried red chilli, to taste / as needed — panch phoron
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal until soft and finish with panch phoron and dried chilli tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Cholar Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) chana dal, ¼ cup, grated coconut, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp cumin, to taste / as needed — bay leaf, ¼ tsp cinnamon
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal with whole spices, add fried coconut pieces and finish with Bengali tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Methi Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, to taste / as needed — fenugreek leaves, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Cook dal and chopped methi together; finish with garlic-cumin tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Lau Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) moong dal, to taste / as needed — bottle gourd, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook gourd and dal together, season lightly and finish with cumin-ginger tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Nimki Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) moong dal, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal until smooth, season simply and finish with ginger-cumin tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Steamed Basmati Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, 1½ cups water
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Rinse rice, soak briefly, then cook with measured water until grains are fluffy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Jeera Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, ¼ tsp cumin, 2 tsp ghee, to taste / as needed — bay leaf
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Temper cumin in ghee, add rinsed rice and water, cook covered until fluffy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Peas Pulao
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, ½ cup peas, ¼ tsp cumin, 4–6 cubes whole spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté whole spices and peas, add rice and water, cook covered until grains separate.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables, 4–6 cubes whole spices, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté vegetables and spices, add rice and water, cook covered until done.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Lemon Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice, ½ lemon, 2 tbsp peanuts, to taste / as needed — mustard, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Temper mustard, curry leaves, peanuts and turmeric; toss with rice and lemon juice.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Coconut Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice, ¼ cup, grated coconut, to taste / as needed — mustard, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, ½ cup (dry) urad dal
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Temper mustard and dals, add coconut briefly, toss with cooked rice and salt.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Tamarind Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice, to taste / as needed — tamarind, 2 tbsp peanuts, to taste / as needed — sesame, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook tamarind-spice paste, cool slightly and mix with rice and roasted peanuts.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Tomato Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook tomato-onion masala, add rice and water, cover until fluffy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Curd Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice, ½ cup yogurt, 1 cup milk, to taste / as needed — mustard, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mash cooled rice, mix with yogurt and milk. 2. (13 min) Finish with mustard-curry leaf tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Khichdi
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ½ cup (dry) moong dal, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Wash rice and dal, pressure-cook with spices and extra water until soft.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Masala Khichdi
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ½ cup (dry) moong dal, to taste / as needed — vegetables, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté vegetables and spices, add rice-dal and water, pressure-cook until soft.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ½ cup (dry) yellow moong dal, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp turmeric, 2 tsp ghee
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Pressure-cook washed rice and dal with turmeric; finish with ghee and cumin.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Vegetable Tehari
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, ½ cup peas, to taste / as needed — cauliflower, 4–6 cubes whole spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté vegetables and spices, add rice and water, cook covered until aromatic.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Matar Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ½ cup green peas, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 4–6 cubes whole spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Brown onion and cumin, add peas and rice, cook with measured water.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bengali Mishti Pulao
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup gobindobhog or short-grain rice, 2 tbsp raisins, 2 tbsp cashew, 2 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp cardamom, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Fry nuts and whole spices, toast rice, add sweet seasoning and water, cook until fluffy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Chapati
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp salt optional
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead soft dough, rest, divide, roll thin and cook on hot tawa; puff directly on flame if desired.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Phulka
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, ½ cup water
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead and rest dough, roll evenly, cook on tawa and finish over flame for puffing.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Paratha
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, ½ cup water, 2 tsp oil or ghee
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Make pliable dough, roll with light oil layering, cook on tawa with ghee until golden.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Prepare spiced mashed potato filling, stuff rolled dough, seal and roll gently, cook with ghee.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Gobi Paratha
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, to taste / as needed — cauliflower, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 small finely chopped chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Grate cauliflower and season. 2. (15 min) Stuff dough, roll and cook with ghee.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Methi Paratha
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, to taste / as needed — fenugreek leaves, 4–6 cubes spices, ½ cup yogurt optional
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Knead chopped methi and spices into dough, roll and cook on tawa.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Ajwain Paratha
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, to taste / as needed — ajwain, 2 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Layer dough with ghee and ajwain, fold, roll and cook until crisp.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Missi Roti
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup wheat flour, to taste / as needed — besan, 1 medium finely chopped onion, to taste / as needed — coriander, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix flours and aromatics with water, knead, pat or roll, and cook on tawa.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bajra Roti
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup pearl millet flour, ½ cup hot water, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix flour with hot water, pat between hands or plastic sheets and cook on tawa.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Jowar Bhakri
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup jowar flour, ½ cup hot water, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead with hot water, pat thin, cook on hot tawa and finish over flame.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Makki Roti
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup maize flour, ½ cup hot water, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead with hot water, pat carefully, cook slowly on tawa until firm.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Luchi
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup refined flour, 2 tsp oil, ½ cup water
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Make soft dough, roll small discs and deep-fry until puffed.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Poori
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp salt, 2 tsp oil
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Make firm dough, roll small discs and deep-fry in hot oil until puffed.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Ragi Roti
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup ragi flour, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander, ½ cup hot water
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix ingredients, pat onto a greased surface, transfer to tawa and cook both sides.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Thepla
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, to taste / as needed — fenugreek leaves, ½ cup yogurt, ¼ tsp turmeric, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead methi and yogurt into dough, roll thin and cook with a little oil.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Dosa
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ½ cup (dry) urad dal, to taste / as needed — fenugreek, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Soak rice and dal, grind and ferment. 2. (15 min) Spread batter thin on hot tawa and cook until crisp.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Idli
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup idli rice, ½ cup (dry) urad dal, to taste / as needed — fenugreek, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Soak, grind and ferment batter. 2. (15 min) Steam in greased moulds until set.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Appam
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ¼ cup, grated coconut, to taste / as needed — yeast or fermented starter, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Prepare and ferment a thin rice-coconut batter, swirl in appam pan and cook covered.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Pesarattu
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — whole green gram, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ¼ tsp cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Soak and grind moong with aromatics. 2. (12 min) Spread batter on hot tawa and cook both sides.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Poha
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup flattened rice, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, 2 tbsp peanuts, to taste / as needed — mustard, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, ¼ tsp turmeric
recipes.preparation: 1. (11 min) Rinse poha briefly. 2. (11 min) Temper mustard and curry leaves, sauté onion/potato, add poha and turmeric.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Upma
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup semolina, 1 medium finely chopped onion, to taste / as needed — vegetables, to taste / as needed — mustard, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves
recipes.preparation: 1. (11 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Roast semolina. 2. (11 min) Temper spices, cook vegetables with water, gradually stir in semolina.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Vegetable Cutlet
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potato, 1 small chopped carrot, ½ cup peas, ½ cup (dry) beans, 4 slices breadcrumbs, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil and mash vegetables, season, shape, coat with breadcrumbs and shallow-fry or bake.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Pakora
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — besan, 1 medium finely chopped onion or vegetables, 1 small finely chopped chilli, to taste / as needed — ajwain
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Make thick spiced besan batter, coat vegetables and fry until crisp.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bread Pakora
recipes.ingredients: 4 slices bread, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, to taste / as needed — besan, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Fill bread with spiced potato, dip in besan batter and fry until golden.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Samosa
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup maida, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, ½ cup peas, ¼ tsp cumin, to taste / as needed — coriander, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Prepare firm dough and spiced potato filling, shape triangular parcels and fry on medium heat.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Kachori
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup maida, ½ cup (dry) moong dal, ¼ tsp fennel, 1 small finely chopped chilli, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Make flaky dough, prepare spiced dal filling, stuff and fry slowly until crisp.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Dhokla
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — besan, ½ cup yogurt or lemon, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ¼ tsp fruit salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Prepare aerated besan batter, steam until set and finish with mustard-curry leaf tempering.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Handvo
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ½ cup (dry) lentils, ½ cup yogurt, to taste / as needed — bottle gourd, to taste / as needed — sesame
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Soak and grind rice-lentil mixture, ferment, mix grated gourd, then bake or pan-cook with sesame.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Muthiya
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — besan, 1 cup wheat flour, to taste / as needed — bottle gourd, to taste / as needed — fenugreek, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Mix into firm dough, shape logs, steam, slice and temper with mustard and sesame.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bhel Puri
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup puffed rice, to taste / as needed — sev, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, to taste / as needed — chutneys
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Toss puffed rice with vegetables, chutneys and sev just before serving.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Jhalmuri
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup puffed rice, 2 tsp mustard oil, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, 2 tbsp peanuts, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Toss all ingredients briskly; serve immediately to retain crunch.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Chana Chaat
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp boiled chickpeas, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, ½ lemon, ¼ tsp chaat masala
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Combine cooked chickpeas with chopped vegetables, lemon and chaat masala.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Fruit Chaat
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — mixed fruit, ½ lemon, ¼ tsp black salt, ¼ tsp roasted cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cut fruit, toss with lemon, black salt and cumin just before serving.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Sprout Chaat
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — moong sprouts, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, to taste / as needed — coriander, ½ lemon, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Combine steamed or raw sprouts with vegetables, lemon and spices.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Corn Chaat
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup sweet corn, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, ½ lemon, 1 small finely chopped chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Steam corn and toss with chopped vegetables, lemon and spices.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — soaked tapioca pearls, 1 medium peeled and diced potato, 2 tbsp peanuts, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 small finely chopped green chilli
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Drain soaked sabudana well. 2. (13 min) Temper cumin, cook potato and peanuts, toss with sabudana until translucent.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Aloo Tikki
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potato, ½ cup peas, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 small finely chopped chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander, 4–6 cubes spices
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Season mashed potato, shape patties and shallow-fry until crisp.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Chilla
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) split moong dal, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 small finely chopped chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Soak and grind dal, season, spread batter thin and cook on tawa.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Besan Chilla
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — besan, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, to taste / as needed — coriander, 1 small finely chopped chilli
recipes.preparation: 1. (22 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Make pourable seasoned batter, spread on hot tawa and cook both sides.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Payesh
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, 1 cup milk, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — bay leaf, 2 tbsp raisins
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Slowly simmer rice in milk until creamy, sweeten and finish with cardamom and nuts.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Kheer
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, 1 cup milk, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — nuts
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook rice in milk on low heat until thick; sweeten and garnish with nuts.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Suji Halwa
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup semolina, 2 tsp ghee, 1–2 tsp sugar, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Roast semolina in ghee, add hot water carefully, then sugar and cardamom; cook until glossy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Atta Halwa
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, 2 tsp ghee, 1–2 tsp sugar, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Roast flour patiently in ghee, add hot water, then sugar and cardamom; stir until thick.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Gajar Halwa
recipes.ingredients: 1 small chopped carrot, 1 cup milk, 1–2 tsp sugar, 2 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — nuts
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook grated carrots in milk until reduced, add sugar and ghee, cook until glossy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Halwa
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) yellow moong dal, 2 tsp ghee, 1–2 tsp sugar, 1 cup milk, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (33 min) Soak and grind dal, roast slowly in ghee, add milk and sugar and cook until aromatic.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Besan Ladoo
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — besan, 2 tsp ghee, 1–2 tsp powdered sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — nuts
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Slow-roast besan in ghee until fragrant, cool slightly, mix sugar and cardamom, shape into ladoos.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Nariyal Ladoo
recipes.ingredients: ¼ cup, grated desiccated or fresh coconut, 1–2 tsp condensed milk or sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook coconut with sweetener until cohesive, cool slightly and shape into balls.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Sandesh
recipes.ingredients: 100 g crumbled/grated fresh paneer/chhena, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead fresh chhena smooth, cook gently with sugar until it leaves the pan, cool and shape.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Rasgulla
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — chhena, 1 cup semolina, 1–2 tsp sugar, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead chhena until smooth, form balls and cook in a vigorously simmering sugar syrup.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Payasam
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup milk, 1 cup vermicelli or rice, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — nuts
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook grain or vermicelli in milk, sweeten and finish with cardamom and nuts.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Mango Shrikhand
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup hung yogurt, to taste / as needed — mango pulp, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk hung yogurt smooth, fold in mango pulp, sugar and cardamom, chill.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Shrikhand
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup hung yogurt, 1–2 tsp powdered sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — saffron
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk hung yogurt and sugar until smooth, add saffron-cardamom and chill.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Mysore Pak
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — besan, 2 tsp ghee, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook sugar syrup, gradually add roasted besan and ghee, stir until porous and set in a tray.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Chaler Payesh
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup gobindobhog rice, 1 cup milk, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — bay leaf
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer rice gently in milk until thick, sweeten and perfume with cardamom.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Doodh Pak
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup milk, 1 cup rice, 1–2 tsp sugar, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — saffron, to taste / as needed — nuts
recipes.preparation: 1. (32 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer rice and milk slowly until creamy, sweeten and finish with saffron and nuts.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
recipes.ingredients: 2 eggs, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp pepper
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Beat eggs with chopped vegetables and spices. 2. (8 min) Cook in an oiled pan until set on both sides.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Egg Bhurji
recipes.ingredients: 2 eggs, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, to taste / as needed — coriander, ¼ tsp cumin
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté onion, tomato and spices, add beaten eggs and scramble gently until just cooked.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Egg Curry
recipes.ingredients: 2 eggs, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil eggs and score lightly. 2. (8 min) Make onion-tomato gravy, add eggs and simmer.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bengali Dimer Jhol

recipes.name: Masala Idli
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — idli, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, to taste / as needed — mustard, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves
recipes.preparation: 1. (30 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cube cooked idli, toss with sautéed vegetables and spices until lightly crisp.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Black Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp black tea leaves, 1½ cups water, 1–2 tsp sugar (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Bring water to a boil, add tea leaves and steep for 2–3 minutes. 2. (4 min) Strain and sweeten if desired.
recipes.notes: Plain black tea without milk. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Strong Black Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp black tea leaves, 1½ cups water
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil water, add tea leaves and steep a little longer for a stronger brew. 2. (4 min) Strain and serve.
recipes.notes: Adjust steeping time to taste. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Assam Black Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp Assam tea leaves, 1½ cups water, 1–2 tsp sugar (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pour freshly boiled water over Assam tea leaves, steep for 3–4 minutes, then strain.
recipes.notes: Serve plain or with a little milk. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Darjeeling Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp Darjeeling tea leaves, 1½ cups water
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Heat water until just below a rolling boil, steep tea for 2–3 minutes and strain.
recipes.notes: Light-bodied tea; avoid over-steeping. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Green Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp green tea leaves or tea bag, 1½ cups hot water, ½ lemon (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Use hot rather than boiling water. 2. (4 min) Steep for 2 minutes and remove the leaves or bag.
recipes.notes: Unsweetened by default. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Lemon Black Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp black tea, 1½ cups water, ½ lemon juice, 1–2 tsp honey or sugar (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew black tea, strain, then stir in lemon juice and sweetener if wanted.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Mint Tea
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp black tea or green tea, 1½ cups water, 2 tbsp chopped fresh mint leaves, 1–2 tsp sugar (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Steep tea with rinsed mint leaves in hot water. 2. (2 min) Strain and serve.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Tulsi Tea
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — tulsi leaves, 1½ cups water, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger (optional), 1–2 tsp honey (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer tulsi leaves and optional ginger in water for 4–5 minutes. 2. (5 min) Strain and sweeten after cooling slightly.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Kahwa
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp green tea, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — saffron, 2 tbsp almonds, 1–2 tsp honey
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer spices in water, switch off the heat, add green tea and steep briefly. 2. (5 min) Strain and garnish with sliced almonds and saffron.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Instant Black Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp instant coffee, 1½ cups hot water, 1–2 tsp sugar (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Dissolve instant coffee in hot water, stir well and sweeten if desired.
recipes.notes: No milk. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Milk Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp coffee powder, 1 cup milk, 1½ cups water, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew coffee with a little hot water. 2. (5 min) Heat milk, combine with the coffee and add sugar to taste.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: South Indian Filter Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp filter coffee powder, 1½ cups hot water, 1 cup milk, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew coffee decoction in a South Indian filter. 2. (2 min) Mix with hot milk and sugar, then pour between tumblers to froth.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Strong Filter Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp strong filter coffee powder, 1½ cups hot water, 1 cup milk (optional), 1–2 tsp sugar (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Prepare a concentrated decoction, dilute to taste and serve plain or with hot milk.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Black Coffee
recipes.ingredients: 2 tsp ground coffee or instant coffee, 1½ cups water
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew coffee in hot water and strain if using ground coffee. 2. (4 min) Serve without milk.
recipes.notes: Sugar optional. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Espresso-Style Coffee
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — finely ground coffee, 1½ cups hot water
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Use an espresso machine or moka pot to brew a small, concentrated cup of coffee.
recipes.notes: Equipment-dependent method. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Iced Black Coffee
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — brewed coffee, 1½ cups water, 4–6 cubes ice cubes, 1–2 tsp sugar (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew coffee a little stronger, cool it, then pour over ice and dilute to taste.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Café-Style Latte
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — espresso or strong coffee, 1 cup milk
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew strong coffee. 2. (5 min) Heat and froth milk, then pour it over the coffee.
recipes.notes: Home-style approximation; no special machine required. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Café Mocha
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — coffee, 1 cup milk, to taste / as needed — cocoa powder, 1–2 tsp sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix cocoa and sugar with hot coffee, add warm milk and stir until smooth.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp salt (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Rinse rice until the water runs mostly clear. 2. (13 min) Add water and cook covered until tender; rest for 5 minutes and fluff.
recipes.notes: Everyday steamed rice; water ratio varies by rice variety. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Ghee Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, 2 tsp ghee, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 4–6 cubes whole spices, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Fry whole spices and sliced onion in ghee. 2. (13 min) Add rinsed rice and water, then cook covered until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Khichdi
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rice, ½ cup (dry) moong dal, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp salt, 2 tsp ghee (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (26 min) Cook rinsed rice and dal with turmeric, salt and extra water until soft and porridge-like.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice, 1 small chopped carrot, ½ cup (dry) beans, 1 medium finely chopped spring onion, to taste / as needed — soy sauce, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp pepper, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Stir-fry finely chopped vegetables over high heat. 2. (13 min) Add cold cooked rice, soy sauce and pepper; toss until hot.
recipes.notes: Uses cooled cooked rice. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Dal Tadka
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1½ cups water, 2 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp cumin, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 1 small finely chopped dried red chilli, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pressure-cook dal with turmeric until soft. 2. (16 min) Heat ghee, fry cumin, garlic and chilli, then pour the tempering over the dal.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Yellow Moong Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) split yellow moong dal, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp cumin, 2 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Rinse dal and cook with turmeric and water until soft. 2. (16 min) Add a simple cumin tempering if desired.
recipes.notes: Light everyday dal. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Masoor Dal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) red lentils, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp cumin, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt, 1½ cups water
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Rinse lentils and simmer with turmeric until soft. 2. (16 min) Cook onion and tomato with cumin, then combine and simmer briefly.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Boiled Potatoes
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potatoes, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp salt (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Wash potatoes and boil until a knife slides in easily. 2. (12 min) Drain, cool slightly and peel if desired.
recipes.notes: Useful base for many dishes. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Aloo Jeera
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potatoes, ¼ tsp cumin seeds, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp chilli powder, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil and cube potatoes. 2. (12 min) Fry cumin in oil, add spices and potatoes, and toss until lightly crisp; garnish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Steamed Mixed Vegetables
recipes.ingredients: 1 small chopped carrot, ½ cup (dry) beans, to taste / as needed — cauliflower, ½ cup peas, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cut vegetables evenly and steam until just tender. 2. (12 min) Season with salt and pepper.
recipes.notes: Use any seasonal vegetables. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Simple Cabbage Sabzi
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — cabbage, ¼ tsp mustard seeds or cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Temper seeds and chilli in oil. 2. (12 min) Add shredded cabbage, turmeric and salt; cover and cook until tender, stirring occasionally.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Beans Poriyal
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) green beans, ¼ cup, grated coconut, ¼ tsp mustard seeds, ½ cup (dry) urad dal, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Finely chop beans and cook with a splash of water. 2. (12 min) Temper mustard, dal and curry leaves, then toss with beans and coconut.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Bhindi Fry
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — okra, 1 medium finely chopped onion (optional), ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp coriander powder, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Wash and dry okra thoroughly, slice and fry with spices over medium heat until tender and no longer slimy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Simple Lauki Sabzi
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — bottle gourd, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, 1 medium chopped tomato, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt, ½ cup water
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Peel and cube bottle gourd. 2. (12 min) Cook cumin and tomato with spices, add gourd and a little water, then cover until soft.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Upma
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup semolina, ½ cup water, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ¼ tsp mustard seeds, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, 2 tsp oil or ghee, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (11 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Dry-roast semolina. 2. (11 min) Temper mustard and curry leaves, sauté onion, add water and salt, then stir in semolina until fluffy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Dalia Porridge
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — broken wheat, 1½ cups water or milk, ¼ tsp salt or sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Toast broken wheat lightly, add water or milk and simmer until soft, stirring occasionally. 2. (16 min) Season sweet or savory.
recipes.notes: Category uses Breakfast; seed category must exist. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Oats Porridge
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats, ½ cup milk or water, ¼ tsp salt or sugar
recipes.preparation: 1. (11 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer oats in milk or water, stirring until creamy. 2. (11 min) Add sweet or savory toppings as preferred.
recipes.notes: Category uses Breakfast; seed category must exist. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Dosa
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — dosa batter, 2 tsp oil
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pour a ladle of batter onto a hot greased griddle and spread thinly. 2. (15 min) Cook until the base is golden, flip if desired and serve.
recipes.notes: Uses prepared fermented batter. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Idli
recipes.ingredients: to taste / as needed — idli batter, ½ cup water
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pour fermented idli batter into greased idli moulds. 2. (15 min) Steam until cooked through, usually 10–12 minutes.
recipes.notes: Uses prepared fermented batter. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Chapati
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp salt (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead flour with water into a soft dough. 2. (15 min) Rest, divide, roll into thin discs and cook on a hot tawa, turning until puffed and cooked.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Paratha
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup whole wheat flour, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp salt, 2 tsp ghee or oil
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Knead flour and water into a dough, rest and roll into discs. 2. (15 min) Brush lightly with ghee and cook on a hot tawa until golden on both sides.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Boiled Egg
recipes.ingredients: 2 eggs, 1½ cups water
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Place eggs in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. 2. (8 min) Simmer 8–10 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.
recipes.notes: Contains egg; non-vegetarian classification follows the project’s existing convention. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Omelette
recipes.ingredients: 2 eggs, 1 medium finely chopped onion (optional), 1 small finely chopped green chilli (optional), ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper, 2 tsp oil
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Beat eggs with salt and pepper. 2. (8 min) Pour into a lightly oiled pan, add optional onion and chilli, and cook until set.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Basic Tomato Chutney
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium chopped tomatoes, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 1 small finely chopped dried red chilli, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Cook chopped tomatoes, garlic and chilli in a little oil until soft. 2. (5 min) Cool and blend or mash to the desired texture.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Cucumber Salad
recipes.ingredients: ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, ½ lemon juice, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp black pepper
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Slice cucumber, season with lemon juice, salt and pepper, and serve fresh.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Onion Salad
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium finely chopped onion, ½ lemon juice, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp chilli powder (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Slice onion thinly, rinse briefly if desired, and toss with lemon juice and seasoning.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Dal Soup
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) moong dal or masoor dal, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp cumin (optional)
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Simmer rinsed dal with turmeric and water until very soft. 2. (16 min) Mash or blend, adjust consistency and season.
recipes.notes: Simple thin dal suitable with rice. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Garlic Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 2 tsp oil or ghee, ¼ tsp pepper, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Sauté sliced garlic in oil or ghee until fragrant. 2. (13 min) Add cooked rice, salt and pepper, and toss until heated through.
recipes.notes: Uses already-cooked rice. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Pepper Rice
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup cooked rice, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp cumin, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, 2 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Crush pepper and cumin coarsely. 2. (13 min) Fry with curry leaves in ghee, add cooked rice and salt, and mix well.
recipes.notes: Uses already-cooked rice. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Cumin Potato Curry
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium peeled and diced potatoes, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp coriander powder, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt, ½ cup water
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cube potatoes and cook with cumin and spices. 2. (12 min) Add a splash of water, cover and simmer until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Simple Tomato Curry
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium chopped tomatoes, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp coriander powder, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté onion, ginger and cumin. 2. (12 min) Add tomatoes and spices, cook until soft, and simmer with a little water to make a simple curry.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Sambar
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, to taste / as needed — tamarind, to taste / as needed — sambar powder, to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal until soft. 2. (16 min) Simmer vegetables with tamarind and sambar powder, add dal and cook together until flavors combine.
recipes.notes: Uses prepared sambar powder. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Rasam
recipes.ingredients: 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ cup tamarind water, to taste / as needed — rasam powder, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp mustard seeds, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, ¼ tsp salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer tomato with tamarind water and rasam powder. 2. (12 min) Add a tempering of mustard, cumin and curry leaves; avoid boiling for too long.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Plain Ragi Porridge
recipes.ingredients: 1 cup ragi flour, ½ cup water or milk, ¼ tsp salt or jaggery
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix ragi flour with a little cool water to prevent lumps. 2. (5 min) Stir into simmering water or milk and cook until thick, then season.
recipes.notes: Can be sweet or savory. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Lassi
recipes.ingredients: ½ cup curd, ½ cup chilled water or milk, ¼ tsp sugar or salt
recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk or blend curd with chilled water or milk until smooth. 2. (2 min) Add sugar for sweet lassi or salt and roasted cumin for savory lassi.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
